metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Name of the path to use. This path name will show up in the property editor when selecting a placement of this smart prop in Hammer, allowing selection of a path object in the map to use."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Offset from the start of the path to place the first point."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Offset to apply to the path, specifies a horizontal and vertical offset to apply relative to the up direction."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
"Specifies the space in which the provided input path is to be evalauted.

World Space: The input path will be evaluated in world space, such that child elements will be placed directly on the target path regardless of the transform of the smart prop object.
Object Space: The world space transform of the input path will be ignored and instead the path will be evaluated relative to the transform of the smart prop object.
Element Space: The world space transform of the input path will be ignored and instead the path will be evaluated relative to the transform of the current element within the smart prop. "

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If true, treat the specified up direction as fixed up direction to apply to all elements placed on the path. If false the up direction is just an initial direction."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Compute the spacing distance in the 2d plane defined by the up direction. Most useful when using a fixed up direction, if maintaining a distance in the 2d plane is more important than maintaing distance along the path."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If not using a fixed up direction, provides an initial up direction which will be used to determine the orientation of first element on the path, after that the elements will incrementally update to follow the path and may not match this direction. If Use Fixed Up direction is specified, then all elements will use this direction to deterime their up direction."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Space in which the up direction is defined."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If enabled, the default path values will be treated as world space values, if disabled they are treated as object space values. Typically it makes sense for literal values to be treated as being in object space, but if the values are being supplied by locators they will typically be in world space."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "A set of points defining a path to use when an external path isn't specified. This will be used in the preview and thumbnail for the smart prop. It will also be used when the smart prop is placed in Hammer before a path is selected."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "An element which places an instance of its child elements at a specified interval along a path."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
"Main Graph Only
This refers to a piece of code in the sound engine that will select specific voices to be mixed into this track and at what mix level each voice will be mixed.
If you want to drive that with data, choose "By Named Send" and author a list of send names for this track. Then any sound event can send to one of those names and the audio will be mixed here."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Material group (skin) to assign to use with the model."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "A weight determining the frequency at which this model is placed relative to other models within the detail type. The weights of all models are summed and the probability of selecting this model is its weight divided by the sum weight."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Screen space size [ 0, 1 ] (where 1 is the whole screen) at which the model will begin to to fade out. Anything larger will be fully visible, anything smaller will start to fade out."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Screen space size [ 0, 1 ] (where 1 is the whole screen) at which the model will be completely faded out. Anything smaller than this size will not be visible, anything larger will start fading in."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If enabled, the up direction will be evaluated in world space, such that the object orientation does not affect the surface slope filtering. Additionally if Orient To Surface is 0, then and world space up is enabled, then the object orientation will not affect the rotation of detail model."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Value indicating if the model's up direction should be matched to the surface. Value should be in the [ 0, 1 ] range, where 0 means that the model up will be model (or object space) up and will ignore the surface direction, and 1 indicates that the model up will exactly match the surface normal."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum slope on which the target will be placed. Slope is a [ 0, 180 ] value based on the surface normal where horizontal surface (floor) is 0, vertical surface (wall) is 90, and a horizontal upside down surface (ceiling) is 180."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Maximum slope on which the target will be placed."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum range of random offset to apply along the model's local up direction"

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Maximum range of random offset to apply along the model's local up direction"

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum range of the random rotation to apply the model. Random rotation is applied in the local space of the model. Rotation values are ordered pitch, yaw, roll."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Maximum range of the random rotation to apply the model."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum random scale value to apply to the model."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Maximum random scale value to apply to the model."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum scale to apply to the model based the painted detail prop density. The minimum of the detail and blend weight scale values is multiplied with the random scale value to determine the final scale."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum scale to apply to the model based on the final material layer blend weight. The model will be given this scale value when the layer blend weight equals the minimum blend weight and will be 1.0 when the maximum blend weight has been reached. The minimum of the detail and blend weight scale values is multiplied with the random scale value to determine the final scale. Set this if you want the model to scale up as the material blend fades in. The smaller the value, the smaller the model will start as the material begins to fade in."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Minimum blend weight value for which the model will be placed. If the blend weight value is less than this value, the model will not be placed."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Maximum blend weight value for which the model will be placed. If the blend weight value is more than this value, the model will not be placed."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Blend weight at which the model will be at full density. Must be between the minimum and maximum blend weight values. The density of this model placement will increase with the blend weight value up to this value at which point it will be at full density."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Should instances of this model generate shadows in the lightmap. Note that shadows in the light map will persist even after the model fades out."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
"The reverb can be parameterized either by a delay range (min/max delay in milliseconds) OR by a delay size for each dimension of a box (width/height/depth).
If you set width, height, or depth to anything other than zero, these min/max fields will not be used."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
"The reverb can be parameterized either by a delay range (min/max delay in milliseconds) OR by a delay size for each dimension of a box (width/height/depth).
If you set width, height, or depth to anything other than zero, these min/max fields will not be used."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "The complexity is how many delays are spread along the total delay length.  Max is 12.  More delays will give your space more reflections (more geometric complexity)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "This is a percentage of the delay length to modulate. 100 means you will modulate between 0 and the max delay.  10 means the delay will modulate between 90 and 100 percent of max delay."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "This is the rate at which the delay length changes.  1 means change the delay every delaytime milliseconds.  2 means change the delay after 2*delaytime milliseconds."

metadata.name: MPropertyFriendlyName
metadata.value: "Mod Rate (# of delay intervals before mod)"

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If true the filter is applied to the signal before output.  If false the filter is applied while feeding back into each delay line."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Configure the filter to apply to the delay output.  Usually this should be a lowpass filter."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If width, height, or depth is set min/max size will be ignored.  These dimensions are the size of the room in milliseconds to first reflection."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If width, height, or depth is set min/max size will be ignored.  These dimensions are the size of the room in milliseconds to first reflection."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If width, height, or depth is set min/max size will be ignored.  These dimensions are the size of the room in milliseconds to first reflection."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "How much of the signal to send to the delay lines.  How loud the reflections are."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Additional amp on the width dimension reflections.  Note negative numbers mean this feedback bypasses the filter (predelay)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Additional amp on the height dimension reflections.  Note negative numbers mean this feedback bypasses the filter (predelay)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Additional amp on the depth dimension reflections.  Note negative numbers mean this feedback bypasses the filter (predelay)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Amplification at output in dB for tuning, applied after Wet/Dry mix"

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If zero there are no extra taps.  If non-zero there will be 3 extra taps and this value will adjust their relative phase."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "A simple reverb that approximates the reflections of a box-shaped room."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "This will automatically forward a variable from the sound event that can be used to drive graph behavior."

metadata.value: "If enabled, any changes made to the evaluation state by the target smart prop (as well as modifiers) will only apply locally and will not affect the evaluation state of the parent. Disabling this will allow modifications to the evaluation state by the referenced smart prop to apply the current state of the of the parent. For example if the referenced smart prop applies a transform and you want the transform to affect the elements in the parent after this element, then you should disable local evaluation state."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
"The reverb can be parameterized either by a delay range (min/max delay in milliseconds) OR by a delay size for each dimension of a box (width/height/depth).
If you set width, height, or depth to anything other than zero, these min/max fields will not be used."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
"The reverb can be parameterized either by a delay range (min/max delay in milliseconds) OR by a delay size for each dimension of a box (width/height/depth).
If you set width, height, or depth to anything other than zero, these min/max fields will not be used."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "The complexity is how many delays are spread along the total delay length.  Max is 12.  More delays will give your space more reflections (more geometric complexity)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "This is a percentage of the delay length to modulate. 100 means you will modulate between 0 and the max delay.  10 means the delay will modulate between 90 and 100 percent of max delay."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "This is the rate at which the delay length changes.  1 means change the delay every delaytime milliseconds.  2 means change the delay after 2*delaytime milliseconds."

metadata.name: MPropertyFriendlyName
metadata.value: "Mod Rate (# of delay intervals before mod)"

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If true the filter is applied to the signal before output.  If false the filter is applied while feeding back into each delay line."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Configure the filter to apply to the delay output.  Usually this should be a lowpass filter."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If width, height, or depth is set min/max size will be ignored.  These dimensions are the size of the room in milliseconds to first reflection."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If width, height, or depth is set min/max size will be ignored.  These dimensions are the size of the room in milliseconds to first reflection."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If width, height, or depth is set min/max size will be ignored.  These dimensions are the size of the room in milliseconds to first reflection."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "How much of the signal to send to the delay lines.  How loud the reflections are."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Additional amp on the width dimension reflections.  Note negative numbers mean this feedback bypasses the filter (predelay)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Additional amp on the height dimension reflections.  Note negative numbers mean this feedback bypasses the filter (predelay)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Additional amp on the depth dimension reflections.  Note negative numbers mean this feedback bypasses the filter (predelay)."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Amplification at output in dB for tuning."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "If zero there are no extra taps.  If non-zero there will be 3 extra taps and this value will adjust their relative phase."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "A simple reverb that approximates the reflections of a box-shaped room, copied from previous audio system."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "When true, discard edges within the angle threshold."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Name of the locator. This can be used to reference the locator in this element or its children. If the locator is configurable, the locator will be identified by this name in Hammer."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Offset of the locator relative to the current transform. This allows the locator to be created at an offset location without applying that offset to the current transform."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Scale to apply only to the locator model"

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Controls whether or not the locator can be edited in a smart prop configuration. If enabled an editable locator will appear when the smart prop is placed in Hammer. Any changes to that locator will modify the current transform."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Controls whether or not the configuration of the locator can include scale. If enabled scale can be applied to the editable locator in Hammer. If disabled the scale will not be editable and the current scale will be used."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Create a locator with the current transform. The locator may optionally be configurable, so that its transform can be modified in Hammer."

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: "Save the results of a control value (e.g. envelope level) so that code/stack can query it by name."
